title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar: covered alloy costs and two-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 confirms fixed-price alloy coverage until March 2027, so current alloy movements do not justify an immediate increase on covered material.
Quote quote:7300008 records €5.45/kg with that coverage.
Contract ctr:4600070710 provides 60-day payment terms, which we propose retaining.

We offer €5.30/kg fixed for 24 months against the annual 94,800 kg commitment. Could you arrange the owner's calculation review offered in doc:20260421-70710-M2, separating covered material, subsequent purchases and processing costs? Please explain how the coverage is reflected in your proposed price and whether a longer commitment can improve it further.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar: covered alloy costs and two-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We welcome your proposal for a 24-month commitment and can accommodate the requested 60-day payment terms. As our alloy coverage only extends to March 2027, a 24-month agreement requires an AS-14404 index clause to manage subsequent volatility. Reflecting the extended duration and your volume commitment, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.55 per kg.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.55 per unit. This option features a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 24-month alloy agreement: revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

For clarity, quote:7300008 is your own €5.45/kg quotation, not a rival quotation.

We understand that coverage expires before the proposed agreement ends and can therefore consider symmetrical indexation. We cannot increase annual volume, but can offer a longer contractual commitment. Please review €5.30/kg with a 5% deadband and 60-day payment for either 24 or 36 months. This provides predictable call-offs while sharing subsequent alloy exposure.

Could you obtain an authorized pricing review and confirm which duration achieves your lowest price? We are not requesting private margin information.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 24-month alloy agreement: revised package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We appreciate your clarification regarding the quotation and your willingness to include the AS-14404 index clause. However, the rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company, and our margin and our limits stay internal. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. To support our valued partnership, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our submission remains valid for 7 days.

Our Angebot contains a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We would be delighted to continue working together and supplying your needs from our extensive range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: 24-month alloy agreement: revised package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
